comparison.objective: Insert a hinge-locking pin before safely loading and leveling a platform; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Hole alignment and pin insertion followed by block placement versus recessed tool alignment, collar tuning, relocking and test cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Platform mechanically locked, loaded, level and clear versus repeatable impact absorption without hard-stop contact or drift.
comparison.reason: Both enforce lock-before-operation safety, but their tested manipulation and physical outcomes differ. No material rubric detail is missing.
